name: Nureyev Ballet
description: Few ballets are as inherently political as this masterpiece based on the life of the great Russian dancer and choreographer Rudolf Nureyev. It draws on his artistic prowess and uncompromising will to freedom. Dropped by the Bolshoi Theatre in 2022 for violating LGBTQIA+ censorship laws, it's the first time the ballet has been performed outside of Russia. A powerful and timely work about freedom, artistry, and defiance.
